name: ImageSetBackgroundColor
description: Sets the background color for the image. The background color is used for clearing a region. Setting the background color only affects the subsequent ImageClearRect calls

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: color
params.description:
Background color (The default value is "black"):

- Hexadecimal value of RGB color. For example, specify the color white as ##FFFFFF or FFFFFF.
- String value of color (for example, "black", "red", "green").
- List of three numbers for (R,G,B) values. Each value must be in the range 0-255.
